core.description: Portable daily capabilities plus an on-demand catalog router.

full.description: Expose every allowed migrated capability. Intended only for compatibility testing.

descriptionOverrides.ai-capability-router: Find and run a less-common capability bundled with this plugin. Use when the user names an unfamiliar custom skill, agent, workflow, command, shorthand, or asks whether an existing capability can handle a task.
descriptionOverrides.architecture-diagram: Create a polished architecture diagram as self-contained HTML and SVG. Use when the user asks for an architecture, system, data-flow, component, or infrastructure diagram.
descriptionOverrides.grill-me: Interview the user one question at a time to resolve ambiguity in a plan or design. Use only when the user explicitly asks to be grilled or challenged interactively.
descriptionOverrides.improve-codebase-architecture: Find concrete architecture improvements grounded in the codebase's domain language and existing decisions. Use for architecture audits and refactoring opportunities.
descriptionOverrides.project-suggest: Turn external information into prioritized, codebase-grounded improvement suggestions. Use when the user asks what a project should learn or improve from an article, issue, competitor, or trend.
descriptionOverrides.video: Extract transcripts and produce structured summaries from supported video or podcast links. Use for YouTube, Bilibili, X video, podcast, or local media transcription tasks.
descriptionOverrides.web-quality-audit: Audit a website across performance, accessibility, SEO, and engineering best practices. Use for comprehensive web quality reviews with actionable findings.
descriptionOverrides.write-a-prompt: Create or improve a high-quality prompt for another agent or session. Use when the user asks to write, generate, or optimize a prompt that someone else will execute.
